We are determined to protect lifeform PDC3141-02, for it has as much right to exist as your or I.|Unigard Lom|<ref name="HNN48">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|48|regional/13321_2.html|Dumping Prohibited on PDC3141-02}}</ref>}}
'''Unigard Lom''' was a [[Xenobiologist/Legends|xenobiologist]] and [[Professor/Legends|professor]] at the [[University of Sanbra]]. This [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] was placed in charge of the research into the subject of a [[Lifeform PDC3141-02|unicellular species]] discovered on the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] [[PDC3141-02]]. When the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] halted the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] dumping of [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]] material on the planetoid, [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]], [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the Trade Federation, protested. Lom defended the Republic's position.
